name: mempool.space (Esplora API and explorer pages)
tier_rationale: The Mempool Open Source Project, a community project with a public explorer, documented API and a multi-year track record (A8 community); P211 and P216 record 'mempool.space community'.

reliability.justification: Esplora-compatible reader of the public Bitcoin ledger: balances and transactions are verifiable on-chain data.

esplora_api.title: mempool.space Esplora-compatible REST API (address, address txs)

terms.quote: Per-adapter terms recorded: Esplora, mempool, litecoinspace and Blockchain.com 'open'; BlockCypher and Blockchair 'key-terms'.

esplora_api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P211 cond 6). mempool.space/api/address/{address} and /api/address/{address}/txs (research C0486); one Esplora parser shared with Blockstream and litecoinspace; a configured self-hosted esplora_url is tried first (module). 429 -> RATE_LIMITED and the host is short-circuited for the run, never empty (P211).

explorer_pages.title: mempool.space address pages (manual pivot links)

terms.quote: Per-adapter terms recorded: Esplora, mempool, litecoinspace and Blockchain.com 'open'; BlockCypher and Blockchair 'key-terms'.

explorer_pages.notes: Quote: binding council text (P211 cond 6). Manual links mempool.space/address/{btc_address} (P216, research C0503). V3LUM never fetches pivot links itself (P311).

notes: Shared seed for batches p2-G09-2, p2-G14-2: batches only extend it (mempool_space__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). Undocumented public limits with 429 on bursts (research C0486): min_interval 1 s as politeness floor, crypto ttl 1 h (TTL_CLASSES), no quota block (no figure). Public API free, AGPL server code self-hostable.
